expo.reason: Expo 58.0.26 coordinates reviewed modules core 58.1.0, autolinking 58.1.0, JSI 58.0.23, CLI 58.1.21, Metro config 58.0.23, Babel preset 58.0.26, assets 58.0.21 and filesystem 58.0.14 with React Native 0.88.1. Runtime 1.8.32 regenerates native projects while preserving lifecycle, consent and crash-reporting guards; validate native compilation before merging and startup before release.

@sentry/react-native.reason: Sentry 8.36.0 advances Android 8.62.0 to 8.64.0 and Cocoa 9.33.0 to 9.35.0 and keeps JavaScript SDK 10.78.0 and CLI 3.8.2; its Android Gradle plugin moves to 6.27.0, which only aligns the bundled Android SDK 8.64.0. It resolves every Sentry Android module to one version and restores touch breadcrumbs on the React Native 0.88 New Architecture; the existing breadcrumb sanitizer keeps only their category. The new opt-in watchdog-termination and breadcrumb options stay unused, and replay, profiling and default PII remain disabled. Runtime 1.8.33 regenerates the Android project; validate native builds and startup.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Gesture Handler 3.5.0 advances the native gesture implementation while retaining the app's Pan, Pinch, Tap and composed gesture API. Expo 58.0.26 bundles 3.3.0; validate Android and iOS native builds plus watch-screen drag and screenshot-lightbox gestures in runtime 1.8.32.

react-native-worklets.reason: Worklets 0.14.0 pairs with Reanimated 4.8.0 and supports React Native 0.88. Its Android frame queue starts paused until the host resumes or a headless task runs, and clears its posted flag while taking callbacks. The reviewed Babel 7 adapter still replaces its five Babel core imports. Runtime 1.8.32 rebuilds the native module so the JavaScript and native versions match.

react-native-web.reason: React Native Web 0.21.4 adds public AssetRegistry entry points shared by CJS and ESM. Expo CLI 58.1.11 retains the reviewed legacy registry fallback through the public React Native and React Native Web registries; verify Pages and Hosting exports before delivery.

@babel/core.reason: Babel 8.1.3 fixes spread, block-scoping, module-transform, generator and parser edge cases and compiles mocked TypeScript and JSX test fixtures. Expo and Worklets retain the separately pinned Babel 7 adapter because their transforms still require Babel 7 APIs. Preserve the reviewed adapter source hashes and verify both web exports.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 checks the app and crash-reporting workspace. ESLint uses the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package for its compiler API.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.8.0 supports React Native 0.88 with Worklets 0.14, keeps the Java part of the native proxy until in-flight calls return, and moves event-name resolution into Reanimated. Its NodesManager still keeps callbacks across teardown, so runtime 1.8.32 rebases the callback-cleanup patch and verifies it with the lifecycle fixture and Android/iOS builds.

react-native.reason: React Native 0.88.1 retains the three guarded choreographer and setup sources byte-for-byte. Pin its Metro config, JS polyfills and transitive packages together under runtime 1.8.31.

The upstream patch changes Flight transport/server streams without native/client reconciler implementation changes, and React Native 0.88.0 accepts peer React ^19.3.0. Preserve renderer checks and validate native launch/render behavior under runtime 1.8.26.
